pullRequest.body:
Fixes #14946

### Description

When `--name` is a branch that already exists on the remote, the `createLinkedBranch` mutation returns `linkedBranch: null` with no errors, and `gh issue develop` fails with "API returned empty branch name". That message points at the API and doesn't help the user. Now, when `--name` was given and nothing comes back, the error says the branch may already exist in the target repo. The old message stays for the case without `--name`.

### How did you test this change?

Not tested by hand against github.com. I changed the existing test for this path to stub the response shape posted on the issue (`{"data":{"createLinkedBranch":{"linkedBranch":null}}}`). It failed with the old message before the change and passes after.

### Key points

I kept it to the error message and didn't add a lookup for the branch before the mutation. That would be one more API call on every run just to improve an error. I also wrote "may already exist" because the API doesn't say why it returned null.
